$comment: Machine form of the per-pin string classification (DESIGN §3.10; prose rationale and the canonical class definitions live in docs/coverage.md 'String classification'). Keyed by named schema $def × property. Every string-valued path in a query output schema resolves here via its owning $def type; a string property NOT listed resolves to the fail-safe default authored-prose (never volunteered — pruned from default output and refused without opt-in). Changes get formula-class hand review (DESIGN §7). Gate G3.f derives every query's untrusted path list from (output schema × this artifact) and fails on divergence from the emitted envelope. 0.4.0 (§3.12 payload enrichment) adds: description on ItemRef, RoomRef and InventoryItem; the AlloText/AlloOut pair (interpreted item effects and quest rewards); ItemRequirement (interpreted USE requirements). Every one is registry-class game content read from the mirror's own registries, hand-reviewed with the 0.4.0 change set: they carry no player-authored text, and the fail-safe would otherwise resolve each to authored-prose and DELETE it from every default answer. 0.5.0 (§3.13 payload economy, the leveling loop and the client-parity trio) adds: `for` on ItemRef/InventoryItem/Item (system — the KAMI-vs-ACCOUNT target); `reason` on Liquidation (system enum); the RoomExit/Condition pair for room exits (exit `name` registry, condition `text` registry, the rest system); `levelUpBlockedBy` on KamiVitals and HarvestVitals (system enum); the SkillRow/BonusOut pair (skill `name`/`type`/`description` and bonus `text` registry, the rest system); QuestRequirement (interpreted requirement `text` registry, type/logic/basis system) and QuestRow (`name`/`description` registry, the same classes the QuestRegistry row they replace already carried); the `view` discriminator on a compact quests answer and the `rpcReads.lastError` diagnostic on status (both system); and GasBalance (`address`, `wei` — both system: an address and a decimal integer-as-string). Every one is game content read from the mirror's own registries, an enum, or a numeric — hand-reviewed with the 0.5.0 change set, as the artifact requires. The fail-safe would otherwise resolve each to authored-prose and DELETE it from every default answer, which is why G3.f asserts each new field is really present. 0.5.0 leg 2 adds: `value` on ItemRequirement and Condition (system — the verbatim stored value, a string because a condition's value can be an entity id), and `valueRaw` on Config (system — the verbatim stored uint256 as a decimal string). 0.5.1 (§3.16 the kami sheet, §3.15 head lag) adds: `affinities` on KamiVitals, HarvestVitals and RosterKami (system — a four-value chain enum, NORMAL/EERIE/INSECT/SCRAP, read from the trait registry, never authored); and `headSampledAt` on Status (system — an ISO timestamp). The Stat/Stats pair the same release adds carries no string property at all, so it needs no entry. Hand-reviewed with the 0.5.1 change set, as the artifact requires: the fail-safe would otherwise resolve `affinities` to authored-prose and DELETE it from every default answer. 0.6.0 (§3.17 chain-authoritative recovery) adds the Sync type on status: `lastReconcileAt` (system — an ISO timestamp, the same class headSampledAt carries). Every other property of the block is a number or an array of number pairs and so carries no string at all. Hand-reviewed with the 0.6.0 change set, as the artifact requires: the fail-safe would otherwise resolve lastReconcileAt to authored-prose and DELETE it from every status answer, and a reconcile timestamp that vanishes is exactly the kind of silent omission this release exists to end.
